system.effect:
You belong to the Greenblood Elf Bloodline.

Woodland Passage. Your Moves ignore Difficult Terrain caused by nonmagical undergrowth, roots, and low branches. This does not permit a Step into Difficult Terrain or ignore Greater Difficult Terrain, a solid barrier, or damage from a hazard.
system.description: Leaflike markings and a body responsive to the living world reveal a lineage long shaped by woodland magic.
system.automation: [EFFECT IGNORE: terrain, undergrowth, roots, low branches]

rules.error: "roots" is not a terrain kind: write Mud, Shallow Water, Decking, Loose Stone, Rubble, Undergrowth, Snow, Ice, Sand or Other
